attchmntText: Hindware Home Innovation Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Hindware Home Innovation Limited filed a presentation on its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the second quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The company reported revenue of 592 crore and EBITDA of 56 crore for the quarter. The Composite Scheme of Arrangement, involving the demerger of the Consumer Products Business into HHIL Limited and the amalgamation of the remaining entity into Hindware Limited, was sanctioned by the NCLT on 14 October 2026. The scheme is pending effectiveness upon filing with the Registrar of Companies. Consequently, the reported financial results do not reflect the scheme. The company aims for mid-teen sales growth in FY27.

attchmntText: Hindware Home Innovation Limited has informed the Exchange about Presentation on Business wise update for Q2 FY2026-27
voiceSummary: Hindware Home Innovation Limited filed a business-wise update presentation for Q2 FY2026-27. In Bathware, sales outlook targets mid-teen revenue growth for FY27 with EBITDA around 11 percent. Net bank debt decreased to 192 crore from 277 crore in H1 FY26. Pipes segment reports 15 percent sales volume growth for FY27 and EBITDA of 4 percent. Net bank debt reduced to 420 crore. Consumer Appliances aims for 15 to 20 percent CAGR over the next two to three years, targeting revenue of 500 crore in two years. The company received the certified true copy of the NCLT order for the Scheme of Arrangement. Listing processes with BSE and NSE will be initiated in due course.

attchmntText: Hindware Home Innovation Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Hindware Home Innovation Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The board also appointed Mr. Nitesh Raj as Chief Executive Officer, Mr. Amit Bali as Chief Financial Officer, and Mr. Kushal Jain as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, all effective 13th November 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations for the half year ended 30th September 2026 was 1,396.07 crore, with a net profit of 10.89 crore. Standalone revenue from operations for the same period was 168.25 crore, showing a net loss of 28.08 crore.
